i18n.zhSummary: 每次进出办公室时收集文件，检查是否有缺陷，并将其发布到系统中。在月初和年度续订时，您会因提交截止日期而不知所措。您是否在浪费时间做这些日常劳动任务？人工智能代理是一种人工智能，当给定目标时，它会自行提出一个程序并连续执行多个任务。在劳工事务中，从检查文件缺陷到将其登记到分类账中以及通知截止日期，一切都可以在没有任何人为干预的情况下完成。但这并不意味着提交通知或解释法律法规的责任将由他们承担。
i18n.enTitle: Utilizing AI agents for labor affairs: Explaining the scope of automation of joining/exiting the company and social insurance procedures and implementation steps
i18n.enSummary: Collect documents every time you enter or leave the office, check for deficiencies, and post them to the system. At the beginning of the month and at the time of annual renewal, you will be overwhelmed with submission deadlines. Are you wasting your time doing these routine labor tasks? An AI agent is an AI that, when given a goal, comes up with a procedure on its own and executes multiple tasks in succession. In labor affairs, everything from checking for document deficiencies to registering them in the ledger and notifying deadlines can be done without any human intervention. However, this does not mean that the responsibility for submitting notifications or interpreting laws and regulations will be left to them.
